metadata.name: CashbackChangeNotification
metadata.description: This webhook is triggered when six consecutive payments of at least the minimum monthly payment amount are made on the account which unlocks bonus earn eligibility by 25%.

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description:
Account Number associated with the event. The Account Number is consistently maintained at the Account level (one-to-one Mapping).
Valid Values: 0-9
Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX
Example: 8000000000000037 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description:
Admin Number associated with the event. Admin Number is always associated with a Card (Can be Primary or Secondary)
Valid Values:0-9
Format:XXXXX
Example:12345

request_fields.name: RequestID
request_fields.description:
Primary Key for API
Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX
Example:12345 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: Mode
request_fields.description: Indicates the type of activity performed which triggered this webhook Possible Value: Alert, Insert, Transaction Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: AccountUniversalUniqueID
request_fields.description:
UniversalUniqueID of Account
Format:XXXXXXXXXX
Example:7408f969-6e0c-4a3f-8fba-3316f6f77db6 Allowable Values: 64

request_fields.name: CardUniversalUniqueID
request_fields.description:
UniversalUniqueID of Card
Format:XXXXXXXXXX
Example:fbe61b75-6751-4add-9c44-7832ccf399e9 Allowable Values: 64

request_fields.name: ClientID
request_fields.description: Corecard's Client ID Allowable Values: 64

request_fields.name: RequestUniversalUniqueID
request_fields.description:
UniversalUniqueID Request
Example: 8638-b87b-48d0-8e13-0ebb5643577 Allowable Values: 64

request_fields.name: UpdateCallList
request_fields.description: Group of fields passed in webhook

request_fields.name: Category
request_fields.description: Group of fields passed in webhook

request_fields.name: CategoryName
request_fields.description:
Indicates category of alert triggered
Possible values:
Account Creation, Payment Schedule, Manage Bank Account, Create Secondary card, Card Replacement, Customer Information, Update Credit Limit, Update Manual Status, Loyalty Redemption, Loyalty Manual Redemption, Loyalty Points Adjustments, Card Activation, CollateralID, Update System Status, Update Card Status, Card Auto Reissue, Dispute Release OTB, PromotionalReward Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: CategoryID
request_fields.description: Numeric unique identifier for Category

request_fields.name: CategoryFieldList
request_fields.description: Array of fields passed in webhook

request_fields.name: ModifiedFieldName
request_fields.description: Indicates cashback policy is updated on the card Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: OldValue
request_fields.description: Represents the previous value of the field being updated. For insert operations, this will be null. This tag is applicable only for updates Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: NewValue
request_fields.description: Indicates the new value assigned to the field being updated/modified. Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: CardnumLast4Digits
request_fields.description: Last 4 digits of Card Number Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: User
request_fields.description:
User ID of the user who triggered the webhook event. 
Valid Values: CoreCredit user, API user, System Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: DateandTime
request_fields.description:
Timestamp when notification was sent
YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss:sss
(24-hour Format)

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description:
Indicates the source from where the activity was performed by user or triggered by system.
Valid Values: CoreCredit, External API, Self Service, CoreCollect, IVR, System, CoreIssue Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: ServiceName
request_fields.description: Name of API service (webhook) triggered Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: AlertType
request_fields.description:
Indicates type of Alert 
Possible values:
Real-Time or Re Try(due to time-out) Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: TransactionSource
request_fields.description: Transaction Source of transaction, IPM, Retail Manual Auth-Installment, Retail Manual Auth-Revolver etc. Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: InstitutionID
request_fields.description: A unique identifier assigned by CoreCard for Institution

request_fields.name: ProductID
request_fields.description: A unique identifier assigned by CoreCard for Product

request_fields.name: AlertRecipientType
request_fields.description:
Type of recipient to which alert needs to be sent
Valid Values:1=Primary Applicant,2=Cosigner,3=Applicant and Cosigner,4=Auth User,5=Applicant and Auth User
